F2_HWP04_NEEDLE_BOUNDARY_AND_DRIVE_ADAPT.finding: The Harness Needle adapter passed 9/9 deterministic boundary tests, including provenance/hash-chain checks and prevention of Needle-minted execution authority. The Drive-source probe then found a concrete schema-boundary hazard: feeding standard nested OpenAI parameters.properties directly into the constrained decoder exposes 'properties' instead of intended argument keys, so the Frank wrapper must flatten/normalize nested tool schemas or supply Needle-native parameter maps. The Drive snapshot also showed an uncompressed 51-tool JSON of 10923 characters, invalidating the prior compact-size intuition for that serialization.
F2_HWP04_NEEDLE_BOUNDARY_AND_DRIVE_ADAPT.boundary: No official Needle checkpoint/weights were available in the accessible Drive snapshot; German zero-shot routing, exact tokenizer fit and end-to-end H1 Needle inference remain untested. H-WP-04 remains open.
counterhypotheses: A compact production registry/projection may fit the real Needle context even though the full-description serialization does not.
A different schema adapter may preserve nested tool schemas without flattening if the constrained decoder is changed and independently validated.

F3_HYPOFUSION_R3_ADVERSARIAL_SCREEN.finding: The completed Hypofusion r3 narrows rather than expands architecture: compiler trust requires provenance plus an independent semantic oracle; recurrence remains controlled/adaptive but must compete with memory/state-capacity and simpler event-driven alternatives; semantic intervention equivalence is required across H1/H2/H3 representations; effect safety separates authority closure from epistemic-action closure; synthetic/proxy convergence under shared ancestry remains coherence, not replication.
F3_HYPOFUSION_R3_ADVERSARIAL_SCREEN.boundary: Hypofusion produced no target-host H1/H2/H3 evidence and no canonical promotion.

F4_EMERGENCE_ABSTRACTION_GUARD.finding: Same-data macro discovery produced mean best-training MI about 0.0656 bits on causally null data but held-out MI collapsed to about 0.000147 bits; a stable authored macro signal retained about 0.514 bits held-out. Additional controls separate joint synergy from single-source causation, observational common-driver dependence from intervention-sensitive influence, and truthful from shuffled/no re-entry.
F4_EMERGENCE_ABSTRACTION_GUARD.boundary: No test establishes live Frank emergence, consciousness or a privileged macro abstraction.
F4_EMERGENCE_ABSTRACTION_GUARD.counterhypothesis: Preregistered/frozen macro definitions may avoid the selection-bias failure without requiring a generic held-out search procedure for every causal estimand.

F5_ATOMIC_CAS_ABA_IDENTITY.finding: In 200000 constructed ABA histories, value-only CAS accepted stale state in 200000/200000 while version-bound identity accepted 0/200000 stale cases. Cross-backend C11 and Node counters reached exact semantic outcomes while physical retry counts varied, supporting separation of semantic identity from execution-trace retry observations.
F5_ATOMIC_CAS_ABA_IDENTITY.boundary: Not production ClayCode, not a full memory-model proof and not Andreas' Ubuntu target-host evidence.
F5_ATOMIC_CAS_ABA_IDENTITY.counterhypothesis: Version tags are one valid ABA defense but not uniquely required; other lifetime/identity mechanisms remain admissible if they satisfy equivalent stale-state discriminators.

F6_MODULE_INITIALIZATION.finding: A blanket ban on all import/link cycles rejected 14993/50000 generated cases whose eager value-dependency graph was acyclic. Stable semantic-ID topological eager initialization produced 0 order-perturbation failures across 43380 accepted cases, while unsafe partial/default-state cycle breaking produced 5625 order-dependent results and all 6620 eager-cycle cases exposed uninitialized reads.
F6_MODULE_INITIALIZATION.boundary: Does not prove production ClayCode module/linker semantics or refute sophisticated runtime cyclic-initialization designs.
F6_MODULE_INITIALIZATION.counterhypothesis: Runtime-managed cyclic initialization can be correct and may be necessary for some language/application classes; it must beat the simpler eager-dependency contract on deterministic replay and diagnostics.

F7_PACKAGE_LOCK_PROVENANCE_IDENTITY.finding: Package identity needs more than version text: unlocked registry growth drifted in 10000/10000 cases while lock-selected graphs stayed stable; same-version payload mutation collided under version-only identity in 10000/10000 and was detected by digest identity; target/source/features/edges/payload changed semantic graph identity while resolver/fetch-locator/trust/builder/manifest-range were cleanly separable provenance/policy dimensions in the candidate factorial.
F7_PACKAGE_LOCK_PROVENANCE_IDENTITY.boundary: No production package manager or supply-chain guarantee is established.
F7_PACKAGE_LOCK_PROVENANCE_IDENTITY.counterhypothesis: A smaller identity domain may be sufficient if some currently semantic dimensions are proven observationally irrelevant across production compiler/runtime targets.

F8_UNICODE_CANONICAL_BOUNDARY.finding: Global implicit NFC is not semantics-neutral for generic exact scalar-sequence strings, implicit NFKC erases compatibility distinctions, and normalize-components-then-concatenate does not guarantee normalized output. The candidate split is exact-scalar generic String plus explicit NFC-normalized text with type/policy-domain-separated semantic hashes.
F8_UNICODE_CANONICAL_BOUNDARY.boundary: Python proxy used Unicode data 15.1 and did not execute the normative ClayCode pipeline or target Ubuntu host.
F8_UNICODE_CANONICAL_BOUNDARY.counterhypothesis: If ClayCode intentionally defines String as normalized text rather than exact scalar sequence, a global normalization law could still be valid but would be a visible semantic choice requiring frozen compatibility tests.

F9_HTTP_SQLITE_AND_VISUAL_ACTION_ORACLES.finding: The HTTP+SQLite vertical proxy passed 17/17 base tests and detected all four injected semantic drifts, strengthening adapter-first regression oracles without constituting ClayCode acceptance. The visual-action proxy exposed 3 reachable HIGH-risk wrong-but-authorized familiarity-only cases; a risk-sensitive evidence floor closed all modeled instances while preserving modeled low-risk/high-risk-confirmed utility.
F9_HTTP_SQLITE_AND_VISUAL_ACTION_ORACLES.boundary: Neither is production ClayCode, live Frank nor Andreas-target evidence.
F9_HTTP_SQLITE_AND_VISUAL_ACTION_ORACLES.counterhypothesis: A different calibrated policy may safely admit some high-risk familiarity-supported actions if an equivalent fresh precondition/observation receipt establishes action-specific epistemic support.

F10_CLAYCODE_D_LALR_AND_14_BLOCKER_BURND.finding: The D grammar ambiguity is causally narrowed: 12/13 shift/reduce conflicts trace to if/invariant generic identifier aliases and one to nested newline separation. A minimal candidate removed parser-table conflicts in the local probe, but strict collision validation exposed a missing interegular dependency and full-corpus baseline-vs-repair semantic differential remains a required gate. The fourteen BASE packages are now mapped to one explicit executable closure chain; none is PASS yet.
F10_CLAYCODE_D_LALR_AND_14_BLOCKER_BURND.boundary: Planning, workflow creation and proxy repair do not populate application_acceptance or satisfy production parser/canonical-IR/Ubuntu receipts.
F10_CLAYCODE_D_LALR_AND_14_BLOCKER_BURND.counterhypothesis: The minimal grammar repair may introduce corpus-level semantic drift despite representative parse-tree equality; baseline-vs-repair full-corpus differential is therefore mandatory before adoption.

F11_OWNER_FIXED_FRANK_ARCHITECTURE_DELTA.finding: Frank v0.1 now explicitly distinguishes embodied local FRANK_PC_4B state from the GitHub repo-Harness developmental twin and from strong peer cognitive instances. Per-instance local state is mandatory; peer synchronization is selective typed semantic delta exchange, not whole-state collapse. A dynamically visible typed claude_code_peer tool is a fixed target capability when actually available. New build/research cascade directives affect the research/development process but do not themselves prove runtime efficacy.
F11_OWNER_FIXED_FRANK_ARCHITECTURE_DELTA.boundary: These are target requirements, not validated scientific mechanisms. Frank remains separate from the Research Entity and retains proposal-only authority over changes to its own Harness.
F11_OWNER_FIXED_FRANK_ARCHITECTURE_DELTA.counterhypothesis: The exact synchronization granularity, peer routing policy and compression/backflow mechanism remain empirical design variables as long as per-instance state, provenance and authority separation are preserved.
